entries.zh: 断人影（使人影踪迹全然断绝；家中悄无声息，似无人一般）
entries.en: to stifle all sound and trace of people — quiet, making no noise at all, as if no one were in the house (sofocar)
entries.notes: 西语栏有涂改痕迹，句义仍可辨（词头当为 Sofocar/Sofoco『使窒闷无声』）；官话栏空。

entries.zh: 断人声（使人声断绝，噤不出声）
entries.en: to silence people('s voices); to stifle the sound in a house
entries.notes: 西语栏词头后有难辨字样『ides』（经圈选），据汉字『断人声』定噤声义。

entries.en: to suspect; to mistrust (sospechar e maliciar)
to suspect; to guess
to wonder at; to be surprised (grouped under sospechar)
entries.notes: 訝为『惊讶』义，与词头 sospechar 的『疑』义相涉而不同，汉义本身明确。

entries.en: to suspect; to doubt
to suspect; mutual distrust, suspicion
to suspect; to grow suspicious
to suspect; to doubt; perplexity
entries.notes: 官话栏所存为残损西语字样（『…falso fingido…』，似指疑其为假伪），非官话对音；据西、汉、闽三栏定疑惑义。

entries.en: suspicion; to suspect

entries.zh: 心思过虑（多心思虑，疑虑重重）
entries.en: to think over anxiously, to overthink; to suspect or ponder (sospechar, pensar)
〔source column damaged; meaning uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏残缺，仅存对音 hva-ly 与词头 sospechar/pensar，无法定夺。

entries.en: to substitute; to replace; in place of another
to substitute for; to act in another's place

entries.zh: 替权（代行其权，代理其事；权且替代）
entries.en: to substitute by proxy; to act under delegated authority (cf. sostituir el poder)
entries.notes: 『替權』搭配罕见，据词头 sostituir 与『權』字推断为代行职权、转委代理之义。

entries.en: to substitute by proxy; delegated substitution
entries.notes: 西语栏词头『sosti fui』被叉划掉，词头不全；据汉字『代權』及上下文定代理义。

entries.en: to substitute; to replace; to take another's place
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺；据西、汉、闽三栏定代替义。

entries.zh: 代（夹注小字『之』）封侯：世代承袭封爵（代代封侯）；一说代其受封
entries.en: to be enfeoffed as marquis life after life, like an office passed down (de vida en vida como el oficio); or to be enfeoffed in another's stead
entries.notes: 『代』下有夹注小字『之』，闽音 tay-tay-hong-hou 亦可读『代代封侯』；西语『de vida en vida como el officio』解为世代承替如职任。

entries.zh: 替手（替工、接替者，顶替劳作之人）
entries.en: a substitute, relief worker; to have another take over the work (sostituir el trabajo por otro)

entries.zh: 替脚（顶替者、替演之人，接替其位置）
entries.en: a stand-in, one who substitutes in the company (troupe); to take another's place
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（『…compania o[残]go』），据『替脚』推断为班社替演、顶替之义，compania 亦可指商伙同行。
